what: Model targets (SLOs) for backlog item 4, checked by cdm.slo each month. Values and how each is judged were set by Claude on 2026-11-09, before any month was judged with them, and accepted by the owner on 2026-11-09 as provisional until replay months 1 to 12 are backfilled with their melanoma referral counts.

melanoma_referral_sensitivity.measure: share of labelled melanoma images the service flags for referral (melanoma probability >= the triage threshold 0.0638, results/phase2/triage/threshold.json), over the owner's trailing window of at least 100 melanoma images, with a 95% Wilson interval
melanoma_referral_sensitivity.judged: on the point estimate (one of the owner's two options): met when at least 0.90, broken when below; the Wilson interval is reported beside it; insufficient data below 100 melanomas
melanoma_referral_sensitivity.why: the threshold was set for 95% sensitivity on validation and reached 96.2% on the client test split, 81.8% at Buenos Aires and 78.8% at PAD-UFES-20 (results/phase2/triage/test.json); 90% leaves room for sampling noise and breaks at the new hospitals' level
melanoma_referral_sensitivity.can_it_be_judged_now: not yet: the trailing window needs each labelled month's referral count, and the committed replay months (1 to 12) predate it. After the replay no labelled months arrive (new ISIC images have no labels), so the target stays 'insufficient data' until months 1 to 12 are backfilled from gold_prediction_audit (refer_melanoma) and their labels, a Databricks run for the owner

delayed_balanced_accuracy.measure: the month's balanced accuracy once its labels arrive (reported by the next month's run)
delayed_balanced_accuracy.judged: broken when below 0.55; insufficient data when fewer than 100 images are labelled
delayed_balanced_accuracy.why: the replay's in-distribution months scored 59.1% to 68.4% at 300 images (results/phase3/monthly, months 2 to 5); 0.55 sits below that range to allow for noise and above the new hospitals' 35% to 45%

abstain_share.measure: share of the month's images whose OOD score is above the abstain threshold
abstain_share.why: the threshold is the validation 95th percentile, so about 5% abstain in distribution (5.7% to 7.3% in replay months 1 to 4); 15% means the review workload has about tripled

alert_path: after every month of a run is saved, the monthly job fails the run with a message starting 'ALERT (not a job error)' that names each month's breaches (a broken target, an overall drift alert, a skin-type drift alert); Databricks emails the owner on a failed run. Wired into databricks/notebooks/monthly_drift.py; not yet deployed
status: provisional (owner, 2026-11-09): accepted values, to be revisited once the months 1 to 12 backfill exists
